# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church was not a suggestion—it was a battle cry. Notice the sequence: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Each command builds on the last. You cannot stand firm if you are not first watchful. You cannot act like men if you have not resolved to stand. And you cannot be strong in your own power; that strength flows from a faith rooted in Christ.

The world tells men to coast, to soften, to retreat when things get hard. But Scripture calls us to a different standard. Watchfulness means keeping your eyes open to temptation, to complacency, to the subtle drift away from God. Standing firm means refusing to be moved when culture pressures you to compromise. Acting like men means taking responsibility, leading your family, and protecting what God has entrusted to you.

Today, you will face moments that test your resolve. A shortcut at work. A temptation in private. A chance to lead or to shrink back. Meet them with the strength that comes from faith, not from ego. You were not made to drift through life—you were made to stand.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep, silently repeat: "Stand firm." Then spend five minutes in prayer, asking God for the strength to act like a man of faith today.
